claim: Explicit rational analytic equivalence on the original admissible level-three source, with exact original j/x identities, and exact exceptional-fiber and cusp orders for the resulting rational j-map.

obligations.name: Exact objects
obligations.required_input: Original level-three admissible quotient, literal arithmetic plane and independently constructed atlases.
obligations.constructed_input: ThreeArithmeticQuotient318.Source, LiteralThreePlanePoints318.Plane and their original comparison; independent open-subspace ParameterOpen atlas.
obligations.justification: planeEquiv only reassociates nested subtypes; quartic_eq_original is rfl. sourceParameter composes the original comparison with the explicit rational inverse.

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.required_input: Every point has j nonzero and j not 1728; literal Q equation.
obligations.constructed_input: Exactly the existing JOpen subtype, with no stronger condition or generic-only exception.
obligations.justification: numerator_ne_zero and denominator_ne_zero derive every division condition from those hypotheses; both inverse laws are checked on the entire domain.

obligations.name: Index and exceptional coverage
obligations.required_input: All admissible points and every exceptional branch in the rational target.
obligations.constructed_input: Two explicit zero branches, every root of D, finite zero cusp and reciprocal infinity chart.

obligations.name: Maps and directions
obligations.required_input: Actual forward and inverse maps and exact j/x compatibility.
obligations.constructed_input: J(T), X(T), T(j,x), sourceParameter and sourceBiholomorph.
obligations.justification: Both original inverse laws are proved, and sourceParameter_j/x and inverse_j/x retain original coordinate functions.

obligations.name: Downstream identity
obligations.required_input: The analytic object used downstream must be the original map, not an arbitrary isomorphic copy.

obligations.justification: The analytic proof consumes the old ambient embedding, not a target topology or complex structure transported from the source.

obligations.name: Coefficients and normalization
obligations.required_input: Original arithmetic j and x conventions, exact scalar factors.
obligations.justification: Polynomial/rational identities are kernel-checked; complex coefficients and characteristic zero are explicit. No q-parameter or period scale is silently identified.

obligations.name: Local analytic application
obligations.required_input: Analyticity in both independently specified atlases and genuine local orders.
obligations.constructed_input: Analytic ambient rational formula, natural parameter open chart, actual source j charts, Mathlib meromorphicOrderAt.
obligations.justification: Nonzero denominator is checked at every actual point; orders use explicit analytic nonzero unit factors on punctured neighborhoods.

obligations.name: Verification
obligations.required_input: Strict checks of exact final source bytes and private-inclusive recursive axiom audit.
obligations.constructed_input: Four final modules compiled with -j1 -M6144 -Ddebug.skipKernelTC=false; audit passes 161 declarations.
obligations.justification: checks and receipt bind sources, imports and baseline pins. Allowed roots only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. This is a local incremental check, not a clean rebuild.

obligations.name: Scope and history
obligations.required_input: Preserve actual compact-source, arithmetic and prior-audit boundaries.
obligations.constructed_input: DERIVATION.md identifies N>=5 restriction of existing all-cusp theorem and failure of same affine x chart at exceptional j.
